notes: A quarterly planning and discovery session. Stresses: an outcome as the goal, customer signal as completed work, an ownership call and a descope as decisions, and a blocker as an error.

messages.content: The goal this quarter is to get new teams to their first shared board within one day.
Customers said the invite flow is the drop-off point. We agreed that onboarding owns the whole first-run path.
Shipped the one-click invite link. In discovery on the template gallery. Blocked on legal for the shared-link policy.
The template gallery slipped to next quarter. We are cutting the custom domain work to protect the date.
how do we know it worked
The requirement is 60 percent of new teams reaching a shared board on day one. Owner is the growth team.
Support tickets are up on the invite email landing in spam. Users reported the link expiring too fast.
